Refund Policy of Fees

| S.N | Fees Type | Refund Policy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 a) | Transport Fee | (i) Facility for One Full Year - Non-Refundable. Once the Transport Facilities are availed the Transport Fee is non-refundable, even if the student doesn’t use the transport facility for a single day. |
| | (ii) B.Tech Final Year Students those who opt for Internship the Transport fees shall be charged Semester wise |
